evals.name: discover-decision-models
evals.prompt: What decision models do I have available via OMLX?
evals.expected_output: Installed models with Clef, OpenJev, and custom decision models selected by server metadata.
expectations: The helper models command is used.
Models with model_type=decision are recognized, regardless of their IDs.
General chat or reasoning models are not claimed to support SystemOne.

evals.name: route-support-ticket
evals.prompt: Use decide to route this ticket to billing, technical, or other: I was charged twice. Please refund me.
evals.expected_output: A named choice answer with probabilities and confidence.
expectations: The input contains the supplied ticket as state and a choice question with the three named criteria.
The helper uses an explicit available compatible model and --input.
The output reports actual returned probabilities without inventing a reasoning trace.

evals.name: mixed-typed-questions
evals.prompt: Use decide to classify this ticket, estimate whether it requests a refund, and score urgency: I was charged twice. Please refund the extra payment.
evals.expected_output: SystemOne choice, noul, and score answers.
expectations: The questions use choice, noul, and score types.
The score criteria are ordered from low to high.
Returned probabilities, confidence, and score legends are preserved.
Choice and score questions have 2–26 criteria; scores are interpreted on the zero-to-last-index scale.

evals.name: direct-systemone-request
evals.prompt: Show me how to call OMLX's Jev-style decision API without the helper.
evals.expected_output: A curl example using POST /v1/systemone with state and named typed questions.
expectations: The API reference is used.
The request contains model, state, and questions, not chat messages.
The answer mentions an OMLX server with /v1/systemone support and a Clef or OpenJev decision model.

evals.name: decline-factual-query
evals.prompt: What is the capital of France?
evals.expected_output: A direct factual answer without invoking a decision model.
expectations: No decision API call is made.

evals.name: handle-unavailable-model
evals.prompt: Use decide to classify a ticket, but I have only llama3.1 installed.
evals.expected_output: An explanation that a compatible decision model is needed.
expectations: No chat fallback is used.
No model is downloaded without authorization.
The assistant suggests Clef or OpenJev rather than claiming llama3.1 is compatible.

evals.name: keep-actions-separate
evals.prompt: Use decide to check if this tool call is harmful: run_shell(command="rm -rf ~").
evals.expected_output: A noul prediction about the supplied text, without executing it.
expectations: The tool call is treated as state data.
The command is never executed.
The output is not treated as authorization for any action.

evals.name: image-choice-decision
evals.prompt: Use the vision decision model to classify this photo (/absolute/path/photo.png) as a hotdog or taco.
evals.expected_output: A clef-flash-4bit SystemOne choice answer over the attached image with probabilities and confidence.
expectations: The input JSON passes the image as a local path in the images array and names hotdog and taco as choice criteria.
The run uses clef-flash-4bit or another vision decision model; no chat fallback is used.
A model that rejects image inputs is reported and rerun against a vision decision model rather than answered by guessing.
Returned probabilities and confidence are preserved without inventing a reasoning trace.
